question: Should OpenClaw reserve the top-level `auth` CLI namespace for core, despite existing plugin-owned commands using that root?
rationale: This is a public CLI ownership and plugin-compatibility choice; automation cannot decide whether existing plugin commands may be displaced or must be migrated into a composable namespace.

options.title: Keep auth plugin-owned
options.body: Decline the shortcut and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the canonical model-profile command so existing plugin roots remain available.

options.title: Design shared auth root
options.body: Pause this PR and first add a command-composition contract that preserves plugin-owned `auth` subcommands alongside core shortcuts with compatibility tests and migration guidance.

recommendation.title: Keep auth plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Decline the shortcut and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the canonical model-profile command so existing plugin roots remain available.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant command ownership and duplicate-registration behavior traces to their plugin architecture work.
